Officer's narrative
On the afternoon in question, I was dispatched to a rear-end collision on a city street in Sugar Land, Texas. Driver 1
was stopped at a traffic signal when the vehicle behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper at a speed
consistent with the damage visible on both vehicles. Driver 2 confirmed that the collision occurred as Driver 1
described it, and two independent witnesses gave statements that matched this account. Scene photographs show
crush damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle and a corresponding impact pattern on the front of Driver 2's vehicle.
Officres confirmed that a Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact, and the witnesses also
placed that person there. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was transported for evaluation. Driver 1 is
listed as an insured party on the policy covering the vehicle. A prior inspection photograph of the rear panel shows a
dent in the same location, which was noted for comparison during this investigation.
</page>
